Maria (CS): Quick sync for Halo dedicated bring-up. Need final quota, autoscale knobs, and a short test tomorrow.
Owen K.: Customer traffic: embeddings steady, chat spikes mid-day. Estimate baseline 28k tok/s, peak 100k tok/s.
Lina (Ops): My draft: reserved=6 GPUs, autoscale min=3 max=22, warm_burst=4. Pre-warm KV for top-25 queries.
Priya (SE): Load plan please? I can run harness if script provided.
Maria (CS): Plan: 8m smoke, 12m ramp to 60%, 12m ramp to 100%, 8m cooldown. Goal p95 < 320ms, error-rate <1.5%.
Owen K.: Canary rollout: 8% for 6m, 40% for 10m, then full. Abort if errors >2% or p95 > 500ms.
ops-bot: Created channel #inc-1778881234-halo-warmup :construction:
Lina (Ops): Autoscale policy: scale_up at GPU_util > 72% for 35s, scale_down at < 30% for 180s, step=+2, cooldown=90s.
Priya (SE): Load command for ops:
```
./loadctl --model redwood-4x --target 100000 --ramp 720 --dur 1440 --kv-prime top25.json
```
Lina (Ops): We'll set temporary cost guard at 130% committed and billing alert if spend delta >20%/hr.
Priya (SE): Pre-run dry smoke in sandbox today 16:00 UTC, will share traces.
Maria (CS): Risk: renewal flagged if we miss p95 SLA for first 72h. Capture in post-test notes.
Owen K.: Add fallback to model-small-v1 on sustained error spikes, and log hallucination checks.
Lina (Ops): Confirm KMS and network egress?
Priya (SE): KMS ok, network rules validated.
Maria (CS): Owners: post-test report -> Owen, enablement checklist -> Priya, ops runbook -> Lina. I'll message customer once window is final.
Priya (SE): :thumbsup:
Lina (Ops): Window tentatively 2025-08-02 09:00-09:45 UTC.
Maria (CS): Great — I'll finalize and add customers to #inc-1778881234-halo-warmup. Thanks! :rocket:
